coverage_claim: A source-grounded reviewable draft of an individual multimodal Vehicle across current road, rail, maritime and aviation identity regimes, physical structure, propulsion, capacity, affordances, recognition, observed state, lifecycle, safety, provenance and exchange, without a claim of universal vehicle-class, jurisdiction, certified crosswalk or autonomous-system completeness.

boundary_decision.status: accepted as an individual physical vehicle
boundary_decision.rationale: The model represents one physical conveyance or mobile machine. Vehicle types, models, variants, components, parties, journeys, cargo, registrations, approvals, certificates, maintenance work and telemetry observations remain distinct linked objects or records.

decisions.rationale: Road, rail, maritime and aviation vehicles share instance, physical-system, capability, state and lifecycle concerns, while each mode retains its own identifiers, categories, authorities and conformance rules.

VIN, IMO number, aircraft registration, European vehicle number and local asset identifiers differ in scope and permanence, so no mutable plate, mark, name, owner, timestamp or hash is universal identity.
Type, model, variant and version describe shared design and approval assertions, while the Vehicle record describes one physical instance and the configuration that applied at a stated time.

Engines, batteries, sensors, control systems and assemblies can have independent identity and lifecycle, so installation records establish whole-part configuration without importing their master records.
Every quantity records unit, tolerance, condition, method, time and source and states whether it is design, declared, measured, estimated or derived.

decisions.concept: Technical capability, current operability and authority
decisions.rationale: A design capability, approval or certificate does not prove that the current configuration is operable, safe, permitted or controlled by the requesting agent.

decisions.concept: Owner, keeper, operator, custodian and occupant
decisions.rationale: Possession, operation, custody and presence never establish legal ownership, and none of these roles determines vehicle identity.
Each record retains its issuer, scope, validity, status, evidence and lifecycle and references the vehicle rather than becoming an intrinsic vehicle property.

Geometry, dimensions, mass, balance, materials, construction, appearance, markings, signals and distinguishing features support machine recognition and physical reasoning in addition to contextual history.
Sensors, procedures, phenomenon time, result time, quality, freshness and provenance remain explicit so current state is not confused with specification or stale evidence.
Control, override, tracking disclosure, ownership change and destructive retirement require active Dimension policy, accountable authority, operating-envelope checks and auditable evidence.
The approved relation ledger contains no outgoing WM-OBJ-007 rows, so proposed sibling composition remains draft.

publication_holds: Claude and Grok timed out during their bounded attempts, so independent external review is absent and explicitly waived for this published reviewable draft.

The approved relationship ledger contains no outgoing relation rows for WM-OBJ-007, so proposed links to vehicle type, component, system, sensor, party, place, journey, cargo, registration, certificate, maintenance, incident, evidence and provenance models remain draft.
Autonomous, remote, unmanned, space, bicycle, micro-mobility and special industrial vehicle profiles require specialist review.
Certified per-mode field crosswalks, unit profiles, conformance fixtures, safety cases and jurisdiction profiles remain unverified.
deferred_research: Develop specialist road, rail, maritime, aviation, space, industrial, bicycle, micro-mobility, autonomous and remotely operated vehicle recipes.

Approve sibling model identifiers and relation cardinalities for types, components, systems, sensors, energy stores, parties, places, journeys, cargo, registrations, certificates, maintenance, incidents, evidence and provenance.
Create deterministic unit, configuration, identity, state, access, deletion, safety and projection fixtures for each supported transport mode.
